item.title: Improve contract search accuracy with auto-generated filters in Amazon Bedrock
item.summary: In this post, we describe how AIDA works at a high level and how it helps address these challenges — grounding users in the right contracts, under the right legal context, and within the right access boundaries. Specifically, we explore how AIDA uses implicit and explicit filtering, along with metadata-enriched chunking in Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, to dramatically improve contract search accuracy.
